\DriverOMP\ residual tolerance
$\varepsilon_{\rm lin}=0.05$ and improvement tolerance
$\eta_{\rm tol}=10^{-3}$; \CoverageDriver\ coverage $\tau=0.95$.
Denominator stabilizers $\delta_0=\eta_0=10^{-3}$; normalized
marginal-gain threshold $g_{\min}=10^{-3}$.
Uniform row weights $w_j=1/n$ for $j=1,\ldots,nr$ give
$W_{\rm row}=\sum_jw_j=r$; Algorithm~\ref{alg:rewrite_coverage_driver}
normalizes coverage by $W_{\rm row}$.
Target normalization guard $\xi=10^{-6}$.
